hmmt-feb-2001-gen1-01.prompt: What is the last digit of $17^{103}+5$?

hmmt-feb-2001-gen1-03.prompt: There are some red and blue marbles in a box. We are told that there are twelve more red marbles than blue marbles, and we experimentally determine that when we pick a marble randomly we get a blue marble one quarter of the time. How many marbles are there in the box?

hmmt-feb-2001-gen1-05.prompt: What is the sum of the coefficients of the expansion $(x+2y-1)^6$?

hmmt-feb-2001-gen1-06.prompt: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of length $2$, and one of its legs has length $1$. The altitude to its hypotenuse is drawn. What is the area of the rectangle whose diagonal is this altitude?
hmmt-feb-2001-gen1-06.reviewNote: The statement does not say which rectangle has the altitude as diagonal; the official answer takes the rectangle with sides along the legs (one vertex at the right angle).
